module: Generator for the ceiling of a Track Builder track segment (useful for tunnels). It defines an inverted-U section profile (width 2, height 1) then extrudes it along the segment's points, with start and end caps according to segment.meshInfo.
notes: getMeshes returns an empty list if segment.quality == 4 or if segment.meshInfo.ceilingMesh.active is false.
Side effect: increments segment.submeshCount and records the index in segment.submeshIndexes.ceilingMesh.

getMeshes.desc: Returns {mesh} for the segment's ceiling, or {} if the ceiling is disabled or quality is low.

segment.desc: Track Builder segment (points, quality, meshInfo.ceilingMesh, materialInfo, submeshCount, submeshIndexes).

returns.desc: List of at most one mesh table {verts, uvs, normals, faces, material, tag}.
